objects.description: [HexEval Loader](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1249) has utilized a cross-platform keylogger that has the capability to capture keystrokes on Windows, macOS and Linux systems.(Citation: Socket HexEval BeaverTail Contagious Interview June 2025)
